Retrieves a list of configured data sources available in the Xceptor platform. Data sources represent connections to external systems from which data is ingested or to which data is exported, including databases, cloud storage, messaging systems, and file systems.

RESTful API for managing data processing workflows, document ingestion, and data extraction in Xceptor. Provides programmatic access to the Xceptor data automation platform for integrating with existing systems and orchestrating automated data processing pipelines. The API supports authentication, job management, data source configuration, and monitoring of processing activities across the platform.
